findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Not done
Re-running `forge close` on an unchanged commit reuses its clean review but records another CI run and wait. With only one review result in the latest worker round, this cutoff never folds those later rows; they accumulate on every retry. A long item delayed by CI can therefore exhaust the body budget, after which `_bounded_body` deletes recent timing rows instead of preserving their summary.
findings.title: Not done: The pull request time record has a fixed size limit: it keeps a time summary for each of the recent rounds and folds older rounds

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 2
Raise: Test
The named proof covers many worker rounds, many reviews in one worker round, and progress in a long current round. None repeats `forge close` while the same clean review is reused and CI records keep arriving. It therefore passes while the record grows without bound on that normal retry path.
